case_order: primary_cases in listed order, then remaining frozen fixture order
boundary: PDP: first target-dependent coefficient descent through independently verified basis, root extraction, original-equation checks and curve replay. Input fixture construction, ring-only plan construction, library loading and result serialization excluded. Algebra controls: frozen coefficient packing through independently certified materialized basis; not complete PDP queries.
cache_policy: Only ring layouts, declared support and input allocations persist. Every target gets fresh coefficients, elimination and independent certification. Matrix-local packed coefficients, pivots and witnesses are destroyed on return or exception; no numerical matrix values or answers are reused.
resource_envelope: One process, one sequential query at a time, one CPU query thread. No GPU, target batching or cross-target answer cache. Native work/node/row limits, not a hard wall timeout.
primary_acceptance: All three qualified trials on all five primary cases must contain seven verified measured pairs, with the lower paired-bootstrap median-ratio 95% bound above one for baseline/packed. No routing promotion follows a partial panel.
two_times_target: A target only: report whether every primary lower bound for baseline/packed reaches two, separately from measured central ratios.
uncertainty: Per-case/trial descriptive paired bootstrap intervals. No familywise or population guarantee. Repeated fixtures do not constitute natural-yield observations.
comparison: Both arms use round 60 leased inputs and round 58 column ordering. Baseline is round 61 bounded scratch XOR; candidate packs matrix rows into 64-bit coefficient words, retaining identical pivot/proof order and historical term-count charges. A 8388608-word payload bound selects the sparse scratch fallback. Conversion, popcounts and output expansion are charged to query wall time.
